summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Fikirizm Cloud. Backend: 17/17 pytest tests pass (auth JWT+Bearer, bootstrap, task CRUD, bulk update, comments, ideas CRUD+vote+convert, dashboard, notifications, members RBAC, search). Frontend: All critical flows verified via Playwright — login->/panel, dashboard cards & charts render with real seeded data, sidebar lists 3 projects, project page defaults to Kanban with 4 status columns, all 4 view switchers (list/kanban/calendar/gantt) work and render correct testids, task drawer opens with all edit controls (title/status/priority/due/rte/comment/delete), new-task-dialog opens, Ideas page shows 5 cards with vote buttons, Members page shows invite button, notifications panel opens, Cmd+K global search opens and returns results for 'Kanban', theme toggle switches to dark, logout returns to /giris. All auth uses Bearer token in localStorage 'fik_token' as documented; /auth/me works with Bearer.

issues: data-testid uses Turkish labels (metric-Açık Görev, metric-Geciken, metric-Bu Hafta, metric-Tamamlanan) instead of the English keys metric-open/metric-overdue/metric-week/metric-done described in the review request. Functionally correct — just a testid naming inconsistency. Either update the spec or normalize testids to stable English keys for easier automation.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Normalize dashboard metric-card data-testids to English stable keys (metric-open, metric-overdue, metric-week, metric-done) to match review spec.
critical_code_review_comments: routes.py is 605 lines — consider splitting into per-resource routers (auth/tasks/ideas/etc.) for maintainability.

Login lockout logic: locked_until is set on every failed attempt AFTER counting (line 110-113) — the lock window resets on each new failure so a legitimate user could be perpetually locked. Consider only setting locked_until once count reaches threshold.
invite_member creates the invited user with the shared DEMO_PASSWORD from env — real invite flow should generate a one-time token / random password and email it, not silently use the demo password.
search endpoint does not escape regex metacharacters in `q` — a user-supplied '(' or unbalanced regex will throw a 500. Wrap with re.escape().

bulk update endpoint (POST /api/tasks/bulk) accepts arbitrary `updates` dict which is written straight to Mongo; allowlist fields (status, priority, tags) to avoid clients writing internal fields like org_id/id/created_by.

WebSocket endpoint accepts any connection without authenticating the user (get_ws_user is imported but not called on /ws/{workspace_id}). Anyone knowing the workspace_id can subscribe to realtime events.

Auth uses Bearer JWT (localStorage key 'fik_token'), NOT cookies (per platform CORS constraints). Metric card data-testids on dashboard are Turkish-labelled.
